title: 第13章 追查蛊源第14章 家族来人
lines: 公开驱蛊法后的第三天，青云坊市的“噬灵蛊瘟疫”
得到了有效控制。
绝大多数感染者通过林澈公开的方法自救成功，只有少数病情过重、发现太晚的，还需要妙手堂的专业治疗。
林澈来者不拒，但诊金收得低廉，对于真正的穷苦修士，甚至分文不取。
这让他的声望达到了一个前所未有的高度。
现在走在坊市街上，随处可以听到对“林神医”
的赞誉。
低阶修士们自发组织起来，轮流在妙手堂外围巡逻，防止有人闹事。
连一些中型势力的头领，也派人送来礼物，表达结交之意。
但林澈没有沉溺于这些虚名。
他正在全力追查蛊源。
根据李副队长和血狼佣兵团收集的情报，问题灵石确实来自白家掌控的“青岩矿脉”
但矿脉的具体情况，外人很难探知。
白家对矿脉的管控极其严格，所有矿工都是签了死契的奴仆，进出都要搜身，根本带不出消息。
“矿脉内部一定有问题。”
林澈根据掌握的信息进行判断，“噬灵蛊的虫卵不可能天然生成，必然有‘母巢’或‘培养场’。
而最可能的地点，就是矿脉深处。”
“可我们进不去啊。”
赵虎无可奈何地挠头，“白家的矿脉守卫森严，光是明面上的筑基修士就有十几个，还有阵法防护。
硬闯就是找死。”
周老沉吟道：“或许……可以从矿工身上想办法。
矿工虽然被严密监控，但总要吃饭、总要休息。
他们的家人，大多住在矿脉外围的‘工棚区’。
也许能从那里打开缺口。”
“工棚区？”
林澈眼睛一亮。
青岩矿脉在青云城西八十里的山区，矿工和家属住在山脚下的棚户区，大约有上千人。”
周老说，“白家虽然控制得严，但工棚区鱼龙混杂，也有一些小商贩往来。
我们可以伪装成行商或游医，混进去打听。”
“好主意。”
林澈点头赞同，“不过要小心，白家肯定在工棚区安插了眼线。”
“老夫陪林大夫去。”
周老主动请缨，“我在青云城生活了近百年，对那一带还算熟悉。
而且我认识一个老矿工，十几年前从矿上退下来的，也许能提供些线索。”
“我也去！”
赵虎道，“林兄弟你一个人去太危险，我好歹是筑基期，能照应一二。”
林澈想了想，说：“赵虎跟我去，周老您年纪大了，留在坊市坐镇。
另外，血狼团长那边也打个招呼，万一我们出事，需要接应。”
计划定下。
第二天一早，林澈和赵虎换上普通的粗布衣衫，背着药箱和货篓，扮成游医和跟班，出城向西而去。
八十里路，对修士来说不算远。
content_en:
On the third day after the poison exorcism method was made public, the "soul-eating poison plague" in Qingyunfang City
been effectively controlled.
The vast majority of infected people successfully rescued themselves through the methods disclosed by Lin Che. Only a few were too seriously ill and were discovered too late, requiring professional treatment from Miaoshou Tang.
Lin Che refused to accept anyone who came, but the consultation fee was very low, and for truly poor monks, she would not even charge a penny.
This brought his popularity to an unprecedented level.
Now walking on the streets of Fangshi, you can hear comments about "Miracle Doctor Lin" everywhere.
of praise.
The low-level monks organized themselves and took turns patrolling the outside of Miaoshou Hall to prevent anyone from causing trouble.
Even the leaders of some medium-sized forces sent gifts to express their friendship.
But Lin Che did not indulge in these false reputations.
He is trying his best to trace the source of the poison.
According to the intelligence collected by Vice Captain Li and the Blood Wolf Mercenary Group, the spiritual stone in question does come from the "Qingyan Mine" controlled by the Bai family.
However, it is difficult for outsiders to know the specific conditions of the mineral veins.
The Bai family has extremely strict control over the mines. All miners are slaves who have signed a death contract. They must be searched when they come in and out, so no information can be brought out at all.
"There must be something wrong inside the vein."
Lin Che judged based on the information she had, "It is impossible for the eggs of the soul-eating Gu to be generated naturally, there must be a 'mother nest' or a 'breeding ground'.
The most likely location is deep in the mineral vein. "
"But we can't get in."
Zhao Hu scratched his head helplessly, "The Bai family's mines are heavily guarded. There are more than a dozen foundation-building monks on the surface alone, as well as formation protection.
To break in is to seek death. "
Mr. Zhou muttered: "Perhaps... we can find a solution from the miners.
Although miners are closely monitored, they always need to eat and rest.
Most of their families live in the 'work shed area' on the outskirts of the mine.
Maybe a gap can be opened from there. "
"Workshop area?"
Lin Che's eyes lit up.
"Yes.
The Qingyan Mine is located in a mountainous area eighty miles west of Qingyun City. Miners and their families live in a shanty town at the foot of the mountain, with about a thousand people. "
Mr. Zhou said, “Although the Bai family has strict control, the work shed area is a mixed bag, and there are also some small traders coming and going.
We can pretend to be businessmen or traveling doctors and sneak in to inquire. "
"Good idea."
Lin Che nodded in agreement, "But be careful, the Bai family must have spies in the shed area."
"I'll go with Dr. Lin."
Elder Zhou volunteered, "I have lived in Qingyun City for nearly a hundred years, and I am quite familiar with that area.
And I know an old miner who retired from the mines more than ten years ago. He may be able to provide some clues. "
"I'll go too!"
Zhao Hu said, "Brother Lin, it's too dangerous for you to go alone. After all, I'm in the foundation building stage and can take care of you."
Lin Che thought for a while and said, "Zhao Hu is coming with me. Mr. Zhou is old and will stay in Fangshi to take charge.
In addition, the leader of the Blood Wolf team also wanted to say hello, in case something happens to us and we need to provide support. "
The plan is set.
Early the next morning, Lin Che and Zhao Hu put on ordinary coarse cloth clothes, carried medicine boxes and cargo baskets, pretended to be traveling doctors and followers, and left the city to the west.
Eighty miles is not a long way for a monk.
title_en: Chapter 13: Tracing the source of the poison Chapter 14: Someone from the family
